kurals.tr: Indri Amaiyaach Chirappina Aayinum / Kundra Varupa Vital
kurals.m: Actions that would degrade (one's) family should not be done; though they may be so important that not doing them would end in death

kurals.tr: Seerinum Seeralla Seyyaare Seerotu / Peraanmai Ventu Pavar
kurals.m: Those who desire (to maintain their) honour, will surely do nothing dishonourable, even for the sake of fame

kurals.tr: Perukkaththu Ventum Panidhal Siriya / Surukkaththu Ventum Uyarvu
kurals.m: In great prosperity humility is becoming; dignity, in great adversity

kurals.tr: Thalaiyin Izhindha Mayiranaiyar Maandhar / Nilaiyin Izhindhak Katai
kurals.m: They who have fallen from their (high) position are like the hair which has fallen from the head

kurals.tr: Kundrin Anaiyaarum Kundruvar Kundruva / Kundri Anaiya Seyin
kurals.m: Even those who are exalted like a hill will be thought low, if they commit deeds that are debasing

kurals.tr: Pukazhindraal Puththelnaattu Uyyaadhaal Enmatru / Ikazhvaarpin Sendru Nilai
kurals.m: Why follow men who scorn, and at their bidding wait?

kurals.tr: Ottaarpin Sendroruvan Vaazhdhala�n Annilaiye / Kettaan Enappatudhal Nandru
kurals.m: It is better for a man to be said of him that he died in his usual state than that he eked out his life by following those who disgraced him

kurals.tr: Marundhomatru Oonompum Vaazhkkai Perundhakaimai / Peetazhiya Vandha Itaththu
kurals.m: For the high-born to keep their body in life when their honour is gone will certainly not prove a remedy against death

kurals.tr: Mayirneeppin Vaazhaak Kavarimaa Annaar / Uyirneeppar Maanam Varin
kurals.m: Those who give up (their) life when (their) honour is at stake are like the yark which kills itself at the loss of (even one of) its hairs

kurals.tr: Ilivarin Vaazhaadha Maanam Utaiyaar / Olidhozhudhu Eththum Ulaku
kurals.m: The world will (always) praise and adore the fame of the honourable who would rather die than suffer indignity
